summary: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting the termination of two agreements: a Temporary Use Agreement with Native Markets (effective June 18, 2026) and a HAUS Agreement with Felix Foundation (wind-down agreed June 5, 2026). Under the Native Markets agreement, the company received all fees owed and had 300,000 HYPE tokens unstaked and returned. The Felix agreement expects 500,000 HYPE tokens to be unstaked by June 22, 2026, with full availability by June 29, 2026. The company plans to reposition the ~800,000 HYPE tokens to more profitable strategies. No financial terms beyond asset values (~$10.4M and ~$18.3M) were disclosed. This is a business wind-down, not a special-situation event.
